final.ate_protocol: entire reconstructed trajectory including tails; initial translation only; no intermediate reset, rotation or scale fitting; per-record RMSE then equal-weight record mean
final.rte_protocol: all legal 30-second endpoint pairs within full records; record-balanced RMSE mean; includes record tails
final.displacement_protocol: pooled vector RMSE across all predicted displacement intervals; includes record tails

early.displacement_protocol: pooled vector RMSE across all predicted displacement intervals; includes record tails
